A 60 W bulb and a 100 W bulb, both rated for the same voltage, are connected in series to the mains. Which bulb glows brighter?
a: it depends on the mains voltage
questions.e: The current is the same and $P=I^2R$; the bulb with the lower rated power has the larger resistance.

questions.q: Which statement is correct as the temperature increases?
a: The resistance of both metals and semiconductors increases
The resistance of both metals and semiconductors decreases
The resistance of a metal increases, that of a pure semiconductor decreases
The resistance of a metal decreases, that of a semiconductor increases
questions.e: In a metal, phonon scattering increases; in a semiconductor, the number of carriers grows exponentially.

questions.q: A steady current flows through a wire of varying cross-section. In the thinner part of the wire
a: the current density and the drift speed are larger
